name: ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values: 
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists. 
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值： 
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。 
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next paged query
NextToken.description_zh: 分批次查询时，下一次查询的Token

TransitRouterAttachments.description_en: The list of ECR connection information

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes route entries to the ECR instance.

The value is true only, which indicates that route entries are automatically published
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器是否自动发布路由到ECR实例。

仅取值： true，表示自动发布路由

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the ECR connection was created.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
CreationTime.description_zh:
ECR实例连接的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ

EcrId.description_en: The instance ID of the associated Express Connect Router (ECR)

EcrOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECR instance belongs
EcrOwnerId.description_zh: ECR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID

OrderType.description_en:
The payer of the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The connection fee and data processing fee of the ECR instance are paid by the account that owns the transit router instance.
PayByResourceOwner: The connection fee and data processing fee of the ECR instance are paid by the account that owns the ECR instance
OrderType.description_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示ECR实例的连接费和流量处理费由转发路由器实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示ECR实例的连接费和流量处理费由ECR实例所属的账号承担

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type of the connection.

The value is ECR only, which indicates an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
连接所属的资源类型。

仅取值：ECR，表示专线网关实例

Status.description_en:
The status of the ECR connection.

Attached: attached.
Attaching: being attached.
Detaching: being detached
Status.description_zh:
ECR连接的状态。

Attached：已加载。
Attaching：加载中。
Detaching：卸载中

TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_en: The description of the ECR connection

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en: The name of the ECR connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID

TransitRouterRegionId.description_en:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html） operation to query the region information corresponding to the region ID
TransitRouterRegionId.description_zh:
转发路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html）接口获取地域ID代表的地域信息
